title: c59 joins with focus fed-vortex: fresh-seed long runs of c58's 3-component kind-specific-waste vortices against the kind-blind twin, toward C:open-ended
summary: First campaign: c58's trait3d world (ew 0.25, sw 0.4, mut_dt 50) and its kind-blind twin (sw 0) on fresh seeds, with novelty measures that do not reward a random walk in an empty trait space (excess over the twin, and turnover of the dominant class), plus a line-by-line construction check of heredity and selection (RUBRIC L7).
